purpose: Research request "Places" (area D of the P2 game-substrate plan). District areas and polygons, the compiled map resources, the world community registry and its area nodes, and the streaming blocks, serialised to JSON, for analysing where things are in the world; read together with the TweakDB district, fast-travel, vendor and street-sign records and the cooked journals. Derived from game files: private, ignored by git, never packaged.

tool.name: WolvenKit CLI
tool.whyThisVersion: The same tool, version and settings as areas A and B (quest-corpus-a-manifest.json).

archives.archive/pc/ep1/ep1_1_nightcity.archive: the effective (Phantom Liberty) copies of the streaming blocks, sectors, always-loaded sectors, .areas, .mappins, .poimappins
base copies (compared), .location, .locopaths and the sectors that exist only in the base archive
archives.archive/pc/content/basegame_4_gamedata.a: base journal (through the quest corpus database)
archives.archive/pc/ep1/ep1_2_gamedata.archive: Phantom Liberty journal (through the quest corpus database)

commands: WolvenKit.CLI archive PATH_TO_GAME/archive/pc/content/basegame_3_nightcity.archive -l   (and ep1/ep1_1_nightcity.archive, content/basegame_4_gamedata.archive, ep1/ep1_2_gamedata.archive, content/basegame_1_engine.archive, basegame_2_mainmenu.archive, memoryresident_1_general.archive: path listings, to choose what to extract)

places_archive.py census --game PATH_TO_GAME --archive <each nightcity archive> --paths <listing> --out census.json   (class counts of all 26,340 sector files; reads the archive directly with the game's Oodle DLL)
WolvenKit.CLI extract <ep1_1_nightcity.archive> -o SCRATCH/world -r "03_night_city[.](areas|poimappins|mappins)$"   (and the same for the base archive plus [.](location|locopaths))
WolvenKit.CLI extract <ep1_1_nightcity.archive> -o SCRATCH/al -r "default.(ep1.)?always_loaded_[0-9][.]streamingsector$"   (four sectors; the base archive's three were read for comparison)

WolvenKit.CLI extract <ep1_1_nightcity.archive or basegame_3_nightcity.archive> -o SCRATCH/loc -r "default.(<sector names>)[.]streamingsector$"   (the 117 sectors whose class table has worldLocationAreaNotifier; 109 + 8)

WolvenKit.CLI extract <ep1_1_nightcity.archive> -o SCRATCH/sb -r "default.(<25 sector names>)[.]streamingsector$"   (places_streamable.py: the 965 sectors whose class table has worldCompiledCommunityAreaNode_Streamable, 25 at a time)
WolvenKit.CLI convert serialize SCRATCH/<each file>   (default settings; one file per call: serialising a folder of 117 sectors at once passed the 4 GB limit)
places_index.py areas, places_join.py registry and pins, places_communities.py (the joins; standard library only)
run: Every WolvenKit call ran under tools/memory_guard.py with a limit of 4 GB (peak 2.6 GB for the Phantom Liberty always_loaded_1 sector, about 1 GB for the others). One batch conversion of 117 sectors was killed at the limit and rerun one file at a time. The game was not running.

included: 117 sectors that hold a location-area notifier, and the interior-area sectors (see the interior areas file)
965 sectors that hold streamable community area nodes (read for their area nodes only; not kept)
excluded: sector contents other than area nodes, notifiers, placements and the registry (meshes, collision, lighting, devices' persistent state)
the security areas' types (device persistent state)

Decompiled 2.31 game scripts and the RTTI dump (class and enum layouts)

note: Area D (places) files, added on top of areas A, B, C and H. Tracked copy: research/story-engine/quest-corpus-d-manifest.json. The keyed sha256 values in sourceBytes are of the extracted game files (the decompressed body followed by the buffer segments as stored), which equal WolvenKit's extract output byte for byte. Derived analysis outputs and the analysis scripts are in _derived-d; the repository's reusable versions are research/consumers/quest-corpus/scripts/places_*.py.
